Mahindra Launches First CNG SUV at ₹9.99 Lakh

Mahindra has launched its first sport utility vehicle (SUV) powered by compressed natural gas (CNG), with prices starting at ₹9.99 lakh. The new model offers 200 Nm of torque and a claimed mileage surprise. It is being compared to the Maruti Suzuki Brezza CNG.
